items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: That was a Jolly Roll Martin number, huh?

ctx.x: I wanted to listen to you now, a number that you're going to do to hear the band playing. Now that was, uh, what was it? The Pearls? The Pearls, yeah.

The Pearls, you recorded the Pearls then on Southland. That was a Jolly Roll Martin number, huh? That's right. That's right. That's a good number. You play a solo in that then too, I suppose. Do you, uh, feature just single string solos or what style do you, uh, play or do you have any certain system to work out when you go to play a solo or mixing chords in?
Well, in that particular session I did. Nothing but a single string work, wasn't it? Yeah. Yeah.
